verses.47:8: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَتَعۡسࣰ ا لَّهُمۡ وَأَضَلَّ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ

meaning: The root تَعَسَ primarily means to stumble and fall, often specifically on one's face or hands and mouth. It can also mean to perish, become distant, or be degraded.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
